#include "DesignAudio.h"
#include "SourcePools.h"
#include <iostream>
int main(int argc,char**argv){try{
 using namespace juce;using namespace sp;ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI gui;File root(argv[1]);root.createDirectory();
 auto file=root.getChildFile("source.wav");AudioBuffer<float> input(2,8192);for(int c=0;c<2;++c)for(int n=0;n<8192;++n)input.setSample(c,n,(c+1)*.08f*std::sin(n*.07));
 WavAudioFormat wav;{std::unique_ptr<AudioFormatWriter>w(wav.createWriterFor(file.createOutputStream().release(),48000,2,32,{},0));if(!w||!w->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer(input,0,8192))throw std::runtime_error("fixture audio");}
 auto alternate=root.getChildFile("alternate.wav");input.applyGain(.5f);{std::unique_ptr<AudioFormatWriter>w(wav.createWriterFor(alternate.createOutputStream().release(),48000,2,32,{},0));if(!w||!w->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer(input,0,8192))throw std::runtime_error("alternative");}
 for(auto kind:{"track","master","variation"}){
 DesignDocument d;d.name=String("Baseline v7 ")+kind;d.original.masterDb=0;d.renderSettings.bits=32;d.renderSettings.tailSeconds=0;d.original.layers={makeDesignLayer(inspectDesignSource(file),0,8192,true)};setMixLayout(d.original,channelLayout("stereo-v1"));auto &l=d.original.layers[0];l.locked=true;l.locks=lockFadeIn;l.fadeIn=256;l.fadeOut=128;l.colour=0xff75b59c;d.selectedLayer=l.id;SourcePool pool;auto e=poolEntry(l,d.original.layout);verifyPoolEntry(e);pool.selected=e.id;pool.entries={e};auto alternative=inspectPoolEntry(inspectDesignSource(alternate),0,8192,true);reviewPoolEntry(alternative,l.routing,d.original.layout);pool.entries.push_back(alternative);pool.choiceLocked=true;l.pool=pool;activatePoolEntry(l,alternative.id,d.original.layout);syncPoolSelection(d.original);
 auto gain=makeStockEffect("gain");gain.parameters[0]=-4;gain.locked=true;gain.parameterLocks=1;auto filter=makeStockEffect("filter");filter.parameters[0]=75;filter.parameters[1]=14000;filter.bypass=true;
 if(String(kind)=="track")l.effects={gain,filter};else if(String(kind)=="master")d.original.masterEffects={gain,filter};else{DesignVariation v;v.name="Effects only here";v.mix=d.original;v.mix.layers[0].effects={gain,filter};d.activeVariation=v.id;d.variations={v};}
 auto t=freezeTake(d,"Historical baseline take");t.generation=13;t.outputFrames=4096;t.bodyEnd=4096;t.complete=true;t.kept=true;hashTake(t);d.takes={t};
 auto saved=root.getChildFile(String(kind)+".soundplus");saveDesignAtomic(saved,d);if((int)designToJson(d)["version"]!=7)throw std::runtime_error("Not a genuine manifest 7");auto recalled=loadDesign(saved);
 if(String(kind)=="track"){auto gen=d;gen.takes.clear();auto &gl=gen.original.layers[0];gl.locked=false;gl.effects[0].locked=false;gl.effects[0].parameterLocks=0;gl.effects.push_back(makeStockEffect("delay"));gen.variationSettings.enabled=varyEffects;saveDesignAtomic(root.getChildFile("generation.soundplus"),gen);Array<var> expected;for(auto &v:generateVariations(gen,0x1234))expected.add(designMixToJson(v.mix));root.getChildFile("generation-expected.json").replaceWithText(JSON::toString(var(expected),true));}
 {auto td=d;td.activeTake=t.id;DesignReader reader(td,48000,0,-1,0);AudioBuffer<float> audio(2,4096);if(reader.read(audio,4096)!=4096)throw std::runtime_error("take body");std::unique_ptr<AudioFormatWriter>w(wav.createWriterFor(root.getChildFile(String(kind)+"-take-baseline.wav").createOutputStream().release(),48000,2,32,{},0));if(!w||!w->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer(audio,0,4096))throw std::runtime_error("take PCM");}
 DesignGraph graph(recalled);AudioBuffer<float>b(2,8192);graph.render(b,0,8192);auto out=root.getChildFile(String(kind)+"-baseline.wav");std::unique_ptr<AudioFormatWriter>w(wav.createWriterFor(out.createOutputStream().release(),48000,2,32,{},0));if(!w||!w->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer(b,0,8192))throw std::runtime_error("baseline PCM");std::cout<<kind<<" "<<t.recipeHash<<" "<<t.eventHash<<"\n";
 }
}catch(const std::exception&e){std::cerr<<e.what()<<"\n";return 1;}}
